Basic & Applied Science

Academic Programs & Offerings

Focusing on laboratory investigations, experimental research, and mathematical formulations across natural and physical sciences.

Featured Programs

UG Degree 3 Years

B.Sc in Chemistry (Gen / Hons)

  • Focus areas: Organic, Inorganic, and Physical Chemistry.
  • Advanced streams: Polymer chemistry, molecular structures, spectrum analysis.
  • Includes physical lab testing and qualitative analysis drills.
Careers: Lab Chemist, Quality Analyst, Research Assistant.
UG Degree 3 Years

B.Sc in Physics (Gen / Hons)

  • Focus areas: Classical Mechanics, Electromagnetism, Quantum theory.
  • Advanced streams: Optics, Thermodynamics, solid state physics setups.
  • Emphasizes experimental mechanics and lab research.
Careers: Physics Instructor, Lab Assistant, Technical Auditor.
UG Degree 3 Years

B.Sc in Mathematics

  • Focus areas: Abstract Algebra, Calculus, Real Analysis, Geometry.
  • Advanced streams: Differential equations, statistics, numerical algorithms.
Careers: Statistician, Data executive, Actuarial Assistant.
UG Degree 3 Years

B.Sc in Biotechnology

  • Focus areas: Cell Biology, Genetics, Immunology, Bioprocess Eng.
  • Advanced streams: Recombinant DNA, plant culture, medical genetics.
  • Emphasizes microbial and enzyme laboratory routines.
Careers: Biotech Assistant, Clinical Associate, Biosafety Auditor.
PG Degree 2 Years

M.Sc in Organic Chemistry

  • Focus areas: Advanced Synthesis, Stereo-chemistry, Spectroscopy.
  • Advanced research: Medicinal Chemistry, heterocyclic compound modeling.
Careers: Synthesis Chemist, Drug Developer, Formulation Specialist.
PG Degree 2 Years

M.Sc in Physics

  • Focus areas: Statistical Mechanics, Solid State Physics, Nuclear Physics.
  • Advanced research: Spectroscopy, material synthesis, quantum modeling.
Careers: Project Scientist, material analyst, Research Scholar.
PG Degree 2 Years

M.Sc in Microbiology

  • Focus areas: Fermentation Tech, Food & Medical Microbiology, Virology.
  • Advanced research: Microbial genetics, immunology protocols.
Careers: Microbiologist, QC Specialist, Bio-process Officer.

Department of Design

The Department of Design nurtures creative thinking, visual communication, and problem-solving through studio-based learning, industry projects, and modern design tools including UI/UX, digital media, and product visualization.

Career Opportunities: Graphic Designer, UI/UX Designer, Fashion Designer, Product Designer, Motion Graphics Artist
